ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel regions occupying approximately 70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated on the lateral margins accounting for approximately 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the outer distal margins of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a broad, roughly triangular white region. The right lobe shows a narrower, elongated white band along the trailing edge tip. Fine-grained white speckling is dispersed throughout the central black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle; depth is approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays high-frequency, irregular serrations with peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels in amplitude, most prominent on the medial-to-lateral transition of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a strong upward convex curvature transitioning to a slight concavity near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, circular beige/white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe's black surface, oriented horizontally and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; presence of multiple superficial linear rake marks across the central ventral area.
